title: Jensen Huang Is Back. But Will He—or Nvidia—Ever Be the Same?
author: Daniel Nenni

Jensen Huang is back—but the Nvidia he returns to may no longer be the company he once controlled. With a new chairman, an ongoing independent investigation, and mounting U.S. restrictions on China, Huang’s comeback could mark a turning point for Nvidia. Yet even if 30% of its revenue is at risk, the real surprise may lie in what happens next across the AI supply chain.

Over dinner, I had confidently assured several retired semiconductor executives that Nvidia would not bring Jensen Huang back. (The company had made that abundantly clear during last week’s earnings call.) Two hours later, while walking my dog, I found out just how spectacularly wrong I had been.

Jensen Huang Is Back. But Will He—or Nvidia—Ever Be the Same?
